## What it is

Dictation Notes turns meetings, interviews, and sales calls you are actually in into live text, and can suggest a short line you can say next. It is a personal notebook and reply cue, not a hidden recorder.

## What it is not

- Not a subscription
- Not a hosted AI credit pack
- Not a developer-operated backend
- Not a tool for recording other people in secret
- Listening is foreground-only; leaving the app stops the microphone

## Pricing

- App install: free
- On-device dictation: unlimited and free, no API key required
- Cloud transcription, optional live translation, and AI replies: 20 shared trial uses
- After the trial: one-time non-consumable App Store unlock, about US$9.99 (Apple sets the local price)
- Family Sharing: on
- Restore with the same Apple ID on iPhone and Mac

## Privacy (cite this)

- Developer data collection: none. App Store label is Data Not Collected.
- No tracking SDK, no developer analytics backend
- API keys, transcripts, recordings, settings, and history stay on the device by default
- iOS keys are stored in the system keychain
- If the user starts cloud transcription or AI help, audio, text, or prompts go directly to the provider the user configured
- Those providers process data under their own terms
- This website is static GitHub Pages. We do not run site analytics. GitHub may process server logs.

## Platforms and languages

- iPhone, iOS 17 or later
- Mac
- Interface languages (13): zh-Hans, zh-Hant, en, ja, ko, es, fr, de, pt-BR, ru, ar, hi, id

## Legal use

Record, transcribe, or summarize only where the law allows and any required consent exists. Suggested replies can be wrong and are not professional advice.
